candidates.description: This feature vector activates on subwords and fragments of Hindi script alongside English text and numbers.
This vector activates on Hindi subordinating conjunctions, conditional markers, and relative adverbs denoting time and condition.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs combined with commas or punctuation marks.
These tokens represent common prefixes and initial syllables in the Hindi language.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel signs, nasalization markers, and grammatical suffixes used in Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments of common Hindi words.
These tokens represent various combinations of the consonant 'भ' (bha) with different Hindi vowel matras and conjunct modifiers in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common letter clusters and syllable components in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on sub-word tokens, prefixes, and character n-grams commonly found in Hindi and other Devanagari-script languages.
These tokens are common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflections used to form base action words in the language.
